title: OCD Check test report (the "OCD Check report" issue form)
description: What the OCD Check owner build measured on one phone with one SIM, as pointers: each result names an entry of the closed list of one OCD data commit or release (volte, vowifi, sms_over_ims, video_calling or vonr, on or off, or apn: and a row key that data's apns-conf.xml has for the SIM's network) and the result class the phone measured. It never carries a value: no report can bring a new setting onto a phone. An observation, unverified: it never changes an OCD value, a generated file or a release, and it never makes a phone skip its own test. It holds no IMSI, ICCID, IMEI, phone number, SIP or tel URI, IP address, time of day, location or free text. tools/observed_reports.py checks it against this schema with stdlib code (the keyword subset of tools/validate_public_carrier_data.py), then runs the privacy scan, the consistency checks and the checks against the named commit or release that a schema cannot express.

build.description: Only the owner build tests values; the read-only builds write no test report.

tested_on.description: The UTC date the test run started. A date only, never a time.

release.description: The OCD data the entries point into, with its data digest. Since rule round 29 (S13) the app names the commit it read its data at: the validated main commit it pinned, or the commit its bundled snapshot was built from. The commit must be on OCD's main and carry this data digest. Apps before round 29 name a data release tag instead, which must exist and carry the digest; with a null tag (a bundled snapshot) the release is found by its digest.

data_source.description: pulled: the data the app fetched and checked (since round 29 every file read at the pinned main commit, with one data digest across them; before, a release checked against SHA256SUMS); bundled: the snapshot inside the app.

codename.description: Build.DEVICE, for example x1s: the device tree name LineageOS keys its carrier files by.

rom_family.description: The software family as the app detects it; the build strings themselves are never sent.

ims_stack.description: The IMS service the phone runs: PHH IMS (me.phh.ims), Samsung's (com.sec.imsservice), Google's AOSP ImsStack (com.android.imsstack), another one, or not readable.

build.description: The ROM build the results were measured on: Build.ID and the build's UTC time in seconds (ro.build.date.utc), for example CP2A.260605.016 1792814506. Never the fingerprint, the incremental, the builder's user or host. A settled result needs it (rule round 29: levels are per build).

spn.description: The service provider name the SIM shows, when it has one.

gid1_prefix.description: Only the GID1 prefix of the OCD profile the SIM matched, which OCD publishes; never the SIM's whole GID1.

ocd_profile.description: The most specific profile of the named data the SIM matched; null when none matched.

results_left_out.description: APN row results the app left out so the prefilled issue fits a URL.

code.description: A fixed code from the app, never free text.

result.description: One entry and what the phone measured. reason, call_types, kept, method, restored and settled are left out when they are empty, so the prefilled issue fits a URL.

entry.description: The entry of the named data's closed list: a feature switch and value, or apn: and the row key (the APN in lower case, its types in lower case and sorted, its protocol), which must be a row that data has for the SIM's network.

ocd.description: The entry is OCD's value for this phone and SIM in the named data (this model's device record, or the profile's capability: supported is on, unsupported is off). An APN row entry is always OCD's.

phone.description: The entry is the phone's own value before the test (for an APN row: the phone has the row).

how.description: observed: the phone's own value, seen without a change; tested: set for a while and reverted with proof.

result.description: works: an on entry signed in and passed the T2 call test (an outgoing and an incoming call on its bearer, audio confirmed; volte:on and vowifi:on only), sms_over_ims:on with SMS both ways settled, an off entry of a voice feature took effect and a call went active with it, or mobile data validated with an APN row; signed_in: an on entry registered IMS with the feature's service on its bearer, no call test; service_off: an off entry took effect, the service went, no call measured; not_possible: an on entry cannot be on here (the modem, the IMS stack, the network's offer); failed: the entry was measured and did not work, or the test broke something (the reason says which); not_tested: no result, with the reason.

reason.description: Why: required for not_possible, failed and not_tested.

call_types.description: The calls measured for this entry and the call network type each showed.

kept.description: The entry passed its test and was applied locally (a non-persistent override, or the APN test row kept); left out when not.

method.description: How the phone's value was measured when it could not be seen as it was, for example wfc_override.

restored.description: After the revert the phone's own state came back within the window; false makes a failure unclean.

settled.description: A settled result under rounds 26 to 28 (rule round 29): a pass at L2 or L3, SMS both ways, or a clean measured failure, as the owner build measured it on this ROM build, with the evidence behind it. Only volte:on, vowifi:on and sms_over_ims:on carry it, and only in a report that names a data commit and the ROM build. From the owner's account it is recorded in observed/retested.json as "re-tested by OCD" for 90 days; from any other account it changes nothing and the report stays "reported, not checked by OCD". It never carries a value.

level.description: Round 26's ladder. Voice (volte:on on LTE, vowifi:on on Wi-Fi): l2 calls out (a measured outgoing call on the bearer, audio from packet counts), l3 works (also an answered incoming call on the same bearer). With result failed: the rung the clean measured failure was at (l2 the outgoing call, l3 the incoming call). SMS over IMS: l3 only, an SMS sent and received over IMS (SMS both ways).

bearer.description: The proven bearer: lte for volte:on, iwlan for vowifi:on; for SMS over IMS the IMS bearer when the SMS was sent, when known.

method.description: How each leg was measured: the app's own muted mailbox call, one of the owner's own calls measured passively, both legs for l3 (outgoing+incoming), or the data SMS to the phone's own number.

measured_on.description: The UTC date the level was reached (the newer leg), from the phone's call ledger on the same ROM build: at most 90 days before tested_on, possibly after it, never in the future. The record expires 90 days after it.

test.description: t2: the guided call test's passed outgoing and incoming calls; with_feature_off: a call of the owner's own that went active while the feature was off.
